RE-SHOT AT THIS HEAD. The previous round's pictures were taken before the merge-forward and
before the lineage-claim fix, and one recorded anchor had gone false at the newer head. These
were driven again, on a fresh lane stack, a fresh database, a fresh reader, a fresh
organization, a fresh thread and freshly minted tokens.
THE CARD CROPS HASH IDENTICALLY TO THE 19 AUG ONES, and that is a result rather than a reuse.
The card crop is deterministic - same reading, same agent name, same schedule copy, same
control - so a truthful re-shoot of an unchanged drawing produces the same bytes. The
full-page shots beside them do NOT match, because they carry this run's own thread id in the
breadcrumb and the title bar; those are the frames that show the run is new.
S10 AND S12 ARE REGISTERED IN scripts/ci/chat-hitl-capture-index.json, the file the gate
reads. S11 IS NOT, and its record carries the contract's own two findings verbatim: the
re-proposed reading is the S1 placeholder, which by main's carriage matrix declares no host
and offers nothing to press, so neither chat_thread/pending requirement can be met by the
shipped drawing. An unindexed screenshot counts as zero, and this one is counted as zero.
